stepExplanation: Qc = 2.25 < Kc = 5.0. When Qc < Kc, the system is not at equilibrium and will shift RIGHT (forward) to produce more products until Qc = Kc.
stepBody: Compare Qc (2.25) with Kc (5.0). Is the system at equilibrium? If not, which direction will the reaction shift? (left, right, or at equilibrium)
